defectAnalysis.explanation: Source row 4 contains explicit discount cells E4 (3000.0) and F4 (2000.0) summing to 5000.0 THB, perfectly satisfying 48900.0 - 5000.0 = 43900. The parser set std_disc=0 and sf_disc=0 without populating addOnDiscount or mapping columns E+F, causing the rule engine to calculate RRP - 0 != NetPrice.
defectAnalysis.prescribedAction: Map source discount (E+F) to addOnDiscount and discountValue; leave standardDiscount as 0; evaluate expectedNet = rrp - addOnDiscount for ADD_ON_PURCHASE.
